review_type: Independent SOURCE ONLY review of one real non-training partition manager
verdict: SOURCE PASS conditional on distinct parent admission of exact freeze and disclosed limitations; NOT execution success, training authority, or holdout-opening authority

scope.method: Static source/document review; independent stdlib hashes of frozen candidate files, preserved prior reviews, and three documentary inputs only. No real asset required.

exact_delta_from_synthetic_candidate: New worker replaces synthetic qualification workload with three documentary identity checks, one bounded exact real-source read, one REAL build, one publication, binding verification and redacted RESULT.

New supervisor checks parent isolation flags and frozen inputs, reserves fresh RUN_ONCE, uses existing rb EX|NB lock, forks/reexecs once with -I -S -B, waits/reaps, requires exact successful inventory and binds child public aggregate to its payload.

INPUTS adds exact source/document pins and attribution. PLAN/CAPACITY document real manager exposure, no fallback/retry, aggregate-only release, limitations and admission conditions. Prior evidence is retained unchanged.

checks.parser: 128KiB compressed cap; REAL exact hash and 57523-byte length before decoding; single complete gzip member; 2MiB decoded cap; exact 1797 rows; LF only; 2144-byte line, 65-token and 32-byte/token caps; finite bounded decimal grammar; integral pixels 0..16 and labels 0..9. Scientific exponent is limited to one or two digits. Unknown real lexical compatibility must fail, not trigger an alternate loader.
checks.grouping: SHA256 of all 64 pixel bytes identifies group; repeated hash must match actual pixels and label, else fail. Entire duplicate group receives one fixed domain-hash split. Exact integer 60/20/20 thresholds, no balancing or seed search. TRAIN minimum 10 unique groups for each of 10 classes; both heldouts minimum 100 groups.
checks.worker_input: All three documentary pins rechecked before source open. Source bounded read MAX_COMPRESSED+1; p.REAL enforces fixed content identity. No sklearn/model imports, network or further process launch in worker.
checks.privacy: All row pixels, labels, per-group hashes, multiplicities and source-row mappings occur only in private_manager payloads. Public RESULT/WAIT4 expose fixed documentary identity, whole-file hashes/sizes, aggregate partition group counts, TRAIN-only class coverage and attribution, never heldout class counts or row identifiers. Exceptions use allowlisted fixed categories, no raw exception repr/tracebacks. Child stdout/stderr suppressed.
checks.completion: Five payloads plus COMPLETE.json are binding-verified by unchanged verifier. Parent independently requires seven pre-receipt successful files: five payloads, COMPLETE.json and RESULT.json. It rejects extra successful files including COMPLETE.pending. Parent does not parse private record or manifest semantics; it reads their bytes only for hashes. Private PUBLIC_RECEIPT complete=true alone never establishes success.
checks.lock_and_process: Original benchmark.lock opened rb without creation/replacement, flock EX|NB. Parent retains lock across fork, wait/reap, completion verification and inventory on normal path. Child hard CPU4s, AS128MiB, FSIZE2MiB, alarm30s before exec. Supervisor owned wait4, kill/reap at observed32s and finally cleanup on caught errors. Child explicit local imports with trusted interpreter -I -S -B; parent flags checked.
checks.one_attempt: Fresh exclusive RUN_ONCE reservation consumes attempt before lock acquisition. No cleanup/retry paths, no threshold/seed search or alternate source. Pre-reservation freeze/flag errors exit2 without creating run. Source code does not enforce admission cryptographically; cooperative operator must only run once after parent approval.
checks.capacity: Worker payloads plus marker <=4MiB-65536 before publishing; RESULT <=16384; parent successful pre-receipt inventory <=4MiB-65536 and terminal receipt <=49152. Failure partial artifacts remain. Atomic hardlink transiently creates two marker names; if unlink fails, marker is small and fixed-schema, failure RESULT and fixed supervisor receipt remain within reserve. No arbitrary append/log writes.

expected_accounting.failure: Lock/fork failure can start zero children. Controlled worker parse/build/publish failures produce passed=false and fixed category; normal failed child still reaped. Signals, missing RESULT or verifier issues yield supervisor_failure. Catastrophic supervisor death/filesystem failure can prevent a terminal receipt. No receipt or complete marker alone is success.

unavoidable_exposure: The admitted manager reads all 1797 pixel rows and labels for schema/conflict checks and partition construction. This is declared management exposure, not zero exposure.

Parent verifier management-reads raw private file bytes for bounded hashing without parsing rows. Independent saved reconstruction, if separately admitted, likewise incurs additional manager exposure.

Public aggregate group counts, TRAIN class coverage and whole-file sizes/hashes reveal those aggregates and bindings; they are not row-level release. No cryptographic privacy or administrator-proof seal is claimed.
retained_limitations: Real lexical compatibility, split minima and 128MiB runtime fit are unknown. Preserve any failure without relaxation or retry.

External unhandled SIGTERM/SIGKILL of supervisor can release lock before child ends and prevent reap. Child limits/alarm remain, but no parent-death guarantee or fault/kill qualification exists. Parent must expressly accept this narrow normal-execution scope before admission.

CPU4s is child-only. wait4 measures whole child lifetime; parent observed CPU prefix includes startup, excludes nonzero final serialization/write/teardown. Wall prefix excludes tail; review/tool/reconstruction costs additional. No strict total process-tree CPU or wall proof.

Trusted interpreter/stdlib and cooperative local filesystem required. Frozen hashes and marker bindings do not defeat hostile concurrent writes or authenticate immutable data. No permission or security setting changes are made.
Verifier is byte binding, not semantic reconstruction. Exact parent inventory and separately authorized saved review cover distinct concerns.

Public original UCI TEST subset is repartitioned locally, not an untouched original TEST. No writer IDs/writer-disjoint guarantee. Local bytes not compared to independently downloaded original; provenance/license conclusion inherits preserved documentary audit.
parent_admission_conditions: Approve only exact reviewed freeze with trusted system Python -I -S -B and absolute run_once.py; never separately invoke worker.
Explicitly accept declared manager exposure, empirical-capacity uncertainty, external-supervisor-death limitation and incomplete total timing bounds.
One real attempt only, with exact asset identity, unchanged caps/parser/thresholds and existing lock. Any lexical mismatch consumes attempt and remains failed; no fallback or retry.
After run, require terminal wait4 status and separately admitted saved artifact verification. No G2 training, selection/final evaluation, Fashion, all-FIT, strict256 or HOLD_NEW_TRAIN change follows.
